sessions.notes: Hotel-equipment pull session. Completed before team dinner.

Push. First bench in 7 days (travel). Trained ~12:30pm FASTED - only a sugared energy drink, no pre-lift carb (bread out of the house). Muscle glycogen full from 8/22's 469g carbs. Creatine day 3 (5g/day, started 8/21) - too early for any real effect. Bench 170 first time: 7,5. Set 1 hit the prediction exactly (e1RM ~210 Epley, hits the Sep 1 pace target 9 days early); set 2 dropped 2 reps instead of the usual 1, which matches his established first-week-at-a-new-load pattern (see 7/30 165 6,4 and 8/03 165 7,5, both consolidating to 8,7 by 8/16). Adam overrode two of my calls and was right on both: kept pushdown at 30 (8,7 vs 8,5 on 8/16 - the 8/16 result was a bad day, not too much load) and jumped incline fly 74->80 unprompted (8,5). Lateral raise 10,10,8 and skull crusher 10,8 are both PRs. 4 of 5 lifts progressed. Set count stayed at Adam's usual 2 on bench - I had prescribed a 3rd and he correctly pushed back on changing load and volume in the same session.

Pull is progressing fine on 2 working sets (3 on row); the volume problem is bench-specific.

Every accessory PR'd: pushdown 8,8 at 30, lateral raise 10,10,10 at 25s, incline fly 8,6 at 80, skull crusher 10,10 at 25s. Skull crusher has been stuck at 25 since 7/08 and finally topped out - next session move to 30s.

Creatine day 8: the signature shows up in later-set rep retention - row went 7,6,5 at 170 to 8,8,7 at 175, the per-set dropoff flattening rather than set 1 improving. Prescription policy changed: stop calling holds on pull, let Adam pick the load.

sessions.notes: Push. Bench 175 x 7,5 - ONLY TWO SETS against a prescribed three, and the third set was the entire stated point of this session per the 8/28 diagnosis. UNCONFIRMED whether it was skipped or just unlogged - ask before treating it as skipped. e1RM 215.83, which clears the OCT 1 gate (215) a month early and drops the required rate to 225 by Dec 1 from 1.11 to 0.70 e1RM/wk. Still not 8,7, so 175 REPEATS next push day - the park-at-175 rule stands. THE PATTERN OF THE DAY: load went up on four of five accessories in a single session while bench set count did not. That is backwards relative to the 8/28 diagnosis, which said bench volume is the deficit. INCREMENT SIZE PREDICTED THE OUTCOME: the cable pushdown moved 30->33 (+10%) and held at 7,7. Both dumbbell lifts moved +20% because 5 lb is the smallest DB step at 25 lb - lateral raise 25s 10,10,10 -> 30s 7,6,6, skull crusher 25 10,10 -> 30 for 5. Skull crusher is the 8/29 hamstring-curl error repeated in a different lift, though milder since he dropped down rather than abandoning the set. Context: 25 lb skull crushers took seven weeks (7/08 single set of 6 -> 8/27 10,10), so 30 for 5 is a normal first outing, not a failure. Creatine day 11. Fuel: yogurt bowl 10:30, Proper Food chicken plate 12:30, toast 14:30 1.5h out, all as planned - the best-fed push session of the window, and the lift was moved 12:30 -> 16:00 at Adam's request.

sessions.notes:
Pull, 17:00 - the first session back in the normal evening slot after the day was rebuilt around it at 11:15. FOUR OF FIVE COMPLETE, one regression. Fully fed: latte 11:00, yogurt bowl 11:30, toast ~12:00, gnocchi skillet 12:45 (~2,177 kcal in before training), plus sourdough+butter+oat milk at 15:30 as the pre-lift feed.
LAT PULLDOWN IS THE HEADLINE: 180 x 8,7 is the prescription hit to the rep, e1RM 228.0 from 222.0, and 180 is done in two sessions rather than the four 170 took.
ROW IS THE COST. 175 x 8,6 + 160 x 8 against 175 x 8,8,7 on 8/28 - three fewer reps at the top load. The likely cause is order and fatigue, not capacity: pulldown was materially harder this session (8,7 at 180 vs 7,6) and row follows it. Do not read this as a stall at 175; read it as the pulldown PR being paid for downstream. Repeat 175 x 3 next pull and it should come back.
THE STANDING PATTERN HELD AGAIN: Adam overrode the prescribed load on pullover (37 vs 35) and was right, and held under it on cable curl (63 vs 65) and was right. That is now four straight pull sessions where his own load calls beat mine, which is why the 8/28 policy change stands - stop calling holds on pull, let him pick.
TRAINING-PARTNER DATA (J, and one N entry) was included in the paste covering 7/01-7/21 across pulldown, cable curl, row and DB curl. NOT STORED - weights.json is single-athlete and has no schema for partners. Ask before building one.
